featured_reviews.name: Gautham L
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Blue Dart, especially the Bhandup branch of , has been absolutely frustrating and unacceptable.

I was expecting delivery of my credit card at my wife’s residence. Instead of contacting me directly, the Blue Dart delivery agent, Sandesh Velye, asked the watchman, who mistakenly said no one by my name lives there. Without even attempting to call me, the Blue Dart agent simply left and marked the delivery as failed. This is completely irresponsible and shows a lack of basic professionalism from Blue Dart.

After putting in effort to get the Blue Dart delivery agent’s number, I contacted Sandesh Velye myself. He then spoke in a rude and warning tone, saying he would come the next day but wouldn’t call and that I must be present. Despite this, I adjusted my schedule and waited. Shockingly, he came empty-handed and gave false assurances like “I’ll bring it in the afternoon or tomorrow,” even after I clearly informed him I wouldn’t be available the next day.

The worst part is, the next day Sandesh Velye went to my home and falsely claimed he had called me, which is completely untrue. This kind of dishonesty is unacceptable. How can a company like Blue Dart allow such unprofessional and misleading behavior?

Now, without any proper communication from Blue Dart, my credit card has been redirected to my village address. This entire experience has been full of negligence, poor communication, and blatant lying by the Blue Dart delivery agent.

This is one of the worst courier service experiences I’ve ever had with Blue Dart. Extremely disappointed, and I will definitely be escalating this issue to the Blue Dart corporate office.
